findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_chinese_astrology_zodiac_animals_id" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Retrieve the complete profile of one Chinese zodiac animal: character summary, strengths, weaknesses, trait keywords, the double-hour its Earthly Branch governs…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "chinese-astrology" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: post_chinese_astrology_bazi_compatibility, post_chinese_astrology_bazi_annual_forecast, post_chinese_astrology_calendar_auspicious_days · Private data: get_chinese_astrology_zodiac_animals_id · Public sink: post_chinese_astrology_bazi_chart, post_chinese_astrology_bazi_luck_pillars, post_chinese_astrology_bazi_day_master, post_chinese_astrology_bazi_compatibility, post_chinese_astrology_bazi_annual_forecast, post_chinese_astrology_zodiac_sign, post_chinese_astrology_calendar_lunar_date, post_chinese_astrology_calendar_auspicious_days · Destructive: post_chinese_astrology_bazi_luck_pillars.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: post_chinese_astrology_bazi_compatibility, post_chinese_astrology_bazi_annual_forecast, post_chinese_astrology_calendar_auspicious_days · Private data: get_chinese_astrology_zodiac_animals_id · Public sink: post_chinese_astrology_bazi_chart, post_chinese_astrology_bazi_luck_pillars, post_chinese_astrology_bazi_day_master, post_chinese_astrology_bazi_compatibility, post_chinese_astrology_bazi_annual_forecast, post_chinese_astrology_zodiac_sign, post_chinese_astrology_calendar_lunar_date, post_chinese_astrology_calendar_auspicious_days · Destructive: post_chinese_astrology_bazi_luck_pillars

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
